info.title: Blue Gale Xabungle
info.synopsis: Sul pianeta Zora esistono due società: Gli "Innocenti", una cultura avanzata che vive in città a cupola, e i "Civili", che sono costretti a vivere nell'aspro deserto. Come voluto dgli Innocenti, ogni Civile che commette un crimine è perdonato se non viene consegnato alla giustizia entro tre giorni. Il civile Jiron Amos cerca vendetta sul malvagio fuorilegge Timp Sharon che ha ucciso i suoi genitori, nonostante il periodo di tre giorni sia passato da tempo. Sperando di vendicarsi rubando il mecha Xabungle al mercante Carrying Cargo, Jiron si allea con un gruppo di banditi noti come Sandrats; insieme a loro, rapisce la figlia di Cargo, Elchi, la quale finisce addirittura per essere solidale con la sua causa. La ricerca di vendetta di Jiron si trasforma presto in un conflitto molto più grande, che alla fine vedrà i Civili insorgere contro il governo degli Innocenti.

episodes.title: I Live By Risking My Life!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron Amos is found in the desert by the Sand Rats amidst a battle between them and a Machine Walker. He ends up joining them as they head to the Bazaar.

episodes.title: We`ve Got Xabungle!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron is settling into life with the Sand Rats. Meanwhile, the Sand Rats plot to steal the Xabungle.

episodes.title: Everyone`s Got It Wrong!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and the Sand Rats are on the run in their newly acquired Xabungle! Meanwhile, a reward is put on their heads for their capture.

episodes.title: Why Do You Break The Law?
episodes.synopsis: The Sand Rats learn of Jiron's motives for stealing the Xabungle which involves him avenging the death of his parents.

episodes.title: Three`s a Crowd!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and the Sand Rats prepare for battle and look to head towards Grocky. Are they able to make it through the fight with the Xabungle?

episodes.title: What Are You Up to, Jiron?
episodes.synopsis: Timp has an interesting plan up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Jiron and the Sand Rats are training for their inevitable next battle with Grocky.

episodes.title: Those Who Believe Are Saved
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and the Sand Rats stumble upon a massive oasis, but the respite doesn't last long as they are attacked. Are they able to fend off this foe?

episodes.title: Miss Never Misses!
episodes.synopsis: On the way to a town with a bazaar, the crew is looking for some time to rest but they run into some unexpected trouble before they reach their destination.

episodes.title: In the Field Blooms a Flower Named Maria
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and the Sand Rats run into Maria and some orphans in need. Are they able to help them from their pursuers? Or are they left to their fate?

episodes.title: Brave Women Are Frightening
episodes.synopsis: The Sand Rats' ship is infiltrated by a gang looking to take advantage of their youth. Are they able to hold them off and save the day?

episodes.title: Chase Me! Chase Me!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron goes after Timp alone, but he finds himself in a massive sandstorm. Is he able to enact revenge? Or does he struggle to fight his nemesis?

episodes.title: The Many Mysteries of the Innocent
episodes.synopsis: The Sand Rats come under attack as they get closer to the Innocents. Meanwhile, Jiron continues his pursuit of Timp but where does it lead him next?

episodes.title: A Great Destruction Leaving Nothing Behind
episodes.synopsis: A massive battle ensues while the Sand Rats are on the road. Meanwhile, Jiron learns a huge secret about Timp. Will this change his view on the man he hates so much?

episodes.title: Timp`s Futile Resistance
episodes.synopsis: The Innocent have their Ascension of Light ceremony while Jiron is still on sacred ground with the Xabungle. All the while, Timp is lying in wait for him.

episodes.title: Covered In Mud And Desperate
episodes.synopsis: The Sand Rats' ship comes under heavy attack while Jiron is in bed sick with a fever. In this state, is he able to help the crew?

episodes.title: Sorrowful Elegy
episodes.synopsis: Jiron is taken captive by the Hanawans after he leaves the Iron Gear. While in their clutches he attempts a daring escape!

episodes.title: A Duel with Actors and Noh Theatre
episodes.synopsis: The Hanawans are preparing their all-out attack on the Iron Gear as it is still stranded. Are Jiron and company able to fend off this attack?

episodes.title: What`s Wrong With Running Away from Home?
episodes.synopsis: Jiron thinks Kidd Horla is up to something sinister, but can't he can't quite put his finger on it. What lies in wait for them?

episodes.title: Take Flight, Condor!
episodes.synopsis: An ambush is set up to capture the Xabungle and the Iron Gear, but in a comedy of errors, the would-be attackers aren't as impressive as they seem.

episodes.title: Akon the Stud?
episodes.synopsis: Rag heads out on her own but when going through a thick forest she gets poisoned. An unlikely hero comes to her rescue. Who is he?

episodes.title: Falling in Love, Being in Love
episodes.synopsis: Jiron is inflamed by Rag's apparent defection to Akon, but the real fireworks begin when Kid Horla hatches a duplicitous plan to use Rag to steal a Xabungle.

episodes.title: Rag Broken in Pieces
episodes.synopsis: As the Iron Gear is forced to leave the Bazaar in the aftermath of yet another fight, bitter Rag joins forces with Horla to stage an ambush on her former team.

episodes.title: Rag, Come Back! To My Heart
episodes.synopsis: Rag has been imprisoned onboard the Iron Gear, but when the ship comes under attack by the forces of Gully Karas, the crew desperately needs a second Xabungle pilot.

episodes.title: A Fierce Death Machine! Crying Karas
episodes.synopsis: Rag and Elchi get on each other's nerves, while Karas joins with his wife Greta in a two-pronged assault designed to lead the Iron Gear into an ambush.

episodes.title: A Big Battle of Two Reckless Fighters
episodes.synopsis: To avenge his wife and his brother, Karas asks the Innocent for a ship capable of beating the Iron Gear. And the only thing that can beat it is another Iron Gear!

episodes.title: Chaotic Battle With the Innocent
episodes.synopsis: While Bei's plans cause a factional rift among the Innocent, Elchi's crew transfer to the newer Iron Gear and set forth seeking new Walker Machines.

episodes.title: Sing the Song of the Warrior!
episodes.synopsis: While Jiron gets into a walker battle with a feisty older woman, the Innocent come up with a new plan and order Horla to kidnap either Rag or Elchi.

episodes.title: The Innocent`s Weakness
episodes.synopsis: Biel attempts to turn Elchi against her friends, Jiron and the Iron Gear crew prepare a rescue, and Horla launches his own plan against the Innocent.

episodes.title: Even the Innocent Can Get Desperate
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious organization tries to recruit the Iron Gear and its crew, Biel runs into trouble with the other Innocent, and Jiron discovers an old enemy is still alive.

episodes.title: If They Get the Head, We`re Done For
episodes.synopsis: The Iron Gear continues heading towards Point J and an ambush, Rag meets an attractive guy, and the Innocent attempt to brainwash Elchi.

episodes.title: Manipulating a Woman`s Heart
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and Rag's new associates agree to join forces and stage a raid on an Innocent trade outpost in order to rescue a partially brainwashed Elchi.

episodes.title: My Convenience is Your Convenience
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and Blume fight over what to do after Elchi's betrayal, while Timp Sharon leads a force of new Walker Machines to destroy both the Iron Gear and Salt.

episodes.title: Never Ending Troubles
episodes.synopsis: Everyone plots against everyone else as Katakam and Jiron hatch conflicting plans for the Iron Gear while the defecting Blume accidentally rescues the evicted Biel.

episodes.title: Fatman`s Feelings Fly Far
episodes.synopsis: Leaving behind Katakam and his quarrel with Jiron, Fatman takes off through the snow alone. The others debate splitting their forces and following him.

episodes.title: Military Unit Discovered!
episodes.synopsis: Jiron chases Fatman who's chasing Elchi, Katakam tries to control the Iron Gear, and the Innocent recruit an army composed of thugs, breakers, and a vicious girl gang.

episodes.title: Special Sneaking Mission!
episodes.synopsis: While the now-militarized Elchi trains the Innocent's new troops for battle, Jiron and Fatman reconnect with Blume and Biel, who now have a landship of their own.

episodes.title: A Kaleidoscope of Women
episodes.synopsis: While Kotsett goes crazy with deadly Rat Fever, Chill is sent to Medick's hospital for help... just as Caron and her all-girl gang launch an attack on the facility.

episodes.title: Dance, Elchi!
episodes.synopsis: When Katakam and the SALT forces decide to head towards a new destination, the Iron Gear continues toward Point H and straight into an ambush by Elchi.

episodes.title: Going Solo Is No Go
episodes.synopsis: Elchi's brainwashed personality runs out of control when she kidnaps Maria to use as bait for Jiron, while Rag finally starts to see through Katakam's facade.

episodes.title: Katakam, Ragged Into Bits
episodes.synopsis: The continuing battle between the Iron Gear, Salt, and Gear forces becomes truly chaotic as rival factions within the groups betray each other simultaneously.

episodes.title: End of Katakam
episodes.synopsis: Desperate to prove that he's a capable leader, Katakam launches an attack on Kidd Horla's new landship and forces as they close in on the badly damaged Iron Gear.

episodes.title: Greta Howls
episodes.synopsis: While Jiron learns how to be Salt's new leader and heads to Point Y, Elchi receives a new second in command: Karas' vengeful widow Greta Karas.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Yop
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and Dyke set out to discover the location of Arthur Rank, leader of the Innocent, but are intercepted by the revenge obsessed Greta.

episodes.title: Take Care, Sir Arthur
episodes.synopsis: While the Innocent build a unified army in order to destroy the Iron Gear, Jiron, Rag, and their team attempt to sneak in into Yop to meet with Arthur Rank.

episodes.title: Stand Up to Face the Sun
episodes.synopsis: Having rescued Arthur Rank, Jiron, Rag, and their allies fight to keep the frail Innocent leader alive while his former subordinates attempt to assassinate him.

episodes.title: Sir Arthur Does His Best
episodes.synopsis: The battle for Point V begins as Kid Horla attempts to destroy the Iron Gear using a previously unseen Innocent weapon: self-destructing humanoid shock troops.

episodes.title: Awaken, Elchi!
episodes.synopsis: While Jiron, Rag, and the Iron Gear crew fight against Timp's Unified forces, Arthur and Maria attempt to undo Elchi's brainwashing.

episodes.title: Once and Future Sir Arthur
episodes.synopsis: Greta, Horla, and Timp attack the Iron Gear simultaneously, Dr. Medik tries to purge Elchi's brainwashing and Arthur makes a gallant sacrifice.

episodes.title: Showdown at X Point
episodes.synopsis: Jiron and Chill take on Horla, Timp, and Greta at the same time, Rag rouses the Iron Gear's women to avenge Arthur, and Elchi returns to the fight... but on whose side?

episodes.title: Everybody, Run!
episodes.synopsis: At long last, the final battle begins as Jiron, Elchi, and Rag lead the assault on Point X in the epic conclusion of Blue Gale Xabungle!

episodes.title: Spy Advancement Exam

episodes.title: The Fruit of Love

info.title: Recommendations from Iwamoto-Senpai
info.synopsis: Nel Giappone del 1910, Iwamoto è uno studente di un'accademia militare segreta incaricata di indagare su fenomeni soprannaturali che lo Stato non può rendere pubblici. Durante una missione, incontra un giovane dotato di poteri anomali, emarginato e in pericolo a causa della sua natura. Riconoscendone il valore, Iwamoto gli consegna una lettera di raccomandazione, permettendogli di entrare nell'orbita dell'accademia. Il ragazzo viene così coinvolto in una serie di incarichi che lo portano a confrontarsi con spiriti, misteri e minacce occulte diffuse in tutto il Paese.

episodes.title: Black Snow
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto Kodo has a mission: finding special individuals to attend a special military school.

episodes.title: The Bond-Severing Sickles
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto joins up with another student from Seiho to investigate a mysterious shrine.

episodes.title: The Lad Who Loved Insects
episodes.synopsis: A massive cocoon appears in the barracks, and Iwamoto has to discover where it came from.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Dead and the Gas Refinery
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto comes across a community where rumors of the walking dead lead to a disturbing discovery.

episodes.title: Deicidal Flame
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto is forced to unleash his powers against the mastermind behind the Ryugu Palace slaughter.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Witches
episodes.synopsis: A new recruiting mission puts Iwamoto and Haramachi into conflict with witches from England.

episodes.title: Echoes of Destruction
episodes.synopsis: The clash with the witches continue, with some unexpected assistance coming from Sazame Ryu's rain.

episodes.title: AKA the Box Man
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto is recruited by the person who recruited him, Okuaki Oni, to capture the elusive box man.

episodes.title: The Gap Man and the Box Man
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto's investigation into the box man brings him into conflict with one of his recruits.

episodes.title: The Simultaneous Shooting Stars & the Signal Man & the Spirit Photo Man
episodes.synopsis: When mysterious meteor impacts start peppering the entire Japanese countryside, Iwamoto investigates.

episodes.title: The Poison Man
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto visits a girl's school with his classmates to search for the culprit behind a poisoning incident.

episodes.title: Star Anise
episodes.synopsis: Iwamoto learns the past of the poison man in his time since he escaped the military.

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 1: Kotatsumuri
episodes.synopsis: Nibutani attempts to wake Kumin up, but somehow Kumin keeps dodging. Is she REALLY asleep?

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 2: The Disease Commonly Known as 'Monomorai' or 'Mebachiko' or 'Meibo'
episodes.synopsis: In the clubroom, Yūta Togashi deals with Rikka Takanashi, who puts on a second eyepatch on her left eye after she gets infected with a stye, making her spatially blind. The other girls listen from the outside when Yūta tries to apply eye drops into Rikka's infected left eye.

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 3: Wicked Lord Shingan - Storm Chapter
episodes.synopsis: One day in junior high school, Tomo was roped into helping Rikka develop her apparent abilities. Rikka used Zener cards to test clairvoyance and determined the gender of who entered the classroom to test foresight, both with negative results.

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 4: Dekomori VS Nibutani 2
episodes.synopsis: In the clubroom, Yūta, Kumin, and Makoto Isshiki witness Shinka and Sanae Dekomori playing a game of Old Maid. After ten minutes, the game reaches a climax, in which the last card is torn in half due to Sanae refusing to hand it over to Shinka, thus they both lose and continue to bicker on their way home on a rainy day.

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 5: My Brother 3 - Camping Chapter
episodes.synopsis: Kuzuha Togashi deals with Yūta during his chūnibyō persona during a camping trip. While going to fetch water at a nearby stream, Yūta protects Kuzuha from chestnuts on the ground. The rest of the family later enjoys a meal of curry, but Kuzuha notices that Yūta is sitting by the campfire with a block of meat.

episodes.title: Chunibyo Lite! 6: Summoning an Archangel
episodes.synopsis: In the past, Shinka and Satone Shichimiya spent a day with their two friends attempting to summon an archangel via summoning circle. The paper vessel ended up flying up in the sky due to the wind. In the present, Satone tells this story to Kumin in the clubroom, which embarrasses Shinka.

info.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Rebellion
info.synopsis: Il terzo e ultimo dei tre lungometraggi dedicati a Madoka Magica. Madoka, Sayaka, Kyoko, Mami e Homura sono delle maghe che lottano quotidianamente, fianco a fianco, contro degli esseri malvagi chiamati "Nightmare" che infestano la città di Mitakihara. Tuttavia nella mente di Homura riaffiorano ricordi che le fanno dubitare dell'esistenza stessa del mondo che le circonda: che tutto questo sia opera di una strega?

episodes.title: Parte 1 - L'inizio della storia
episodes.synopsis: Due studentesse Madoka Kaname e Sayaka Miki, sono avvicinate da uno strano essere di nome Kyubey, questi offre loro di diventare delle giovani maghe... ma Homura Akemi, un loro compagna di scuola, cercherà in tutti i modi di impedire loro di sottoscrivere un tale contratto. In questo mondo nascosti ai più esistono creature che possiedono il potere di concedere un desiderio a una ragazza da loro prescelta. Tuttavia quest'ultima per poterlo esprimere deve scegliere di sottoscrivere un contratto e diventare così una maga. Il loro scopo è di lottare contro le streghe, creature malvagie nate da maledizioni, responsabili di omicidi, suicidi ed ogni genere di crudeltà.
